Lucknowi Dhun loosely based on Raag Mishra Bhinna Shadaj. Discover the Royal Music of India with Sitar Maestro Niladri Kumar. Here he performs a Lucknowi Dhun he learnt from his father and Guru Pandit Kartick Kumar at the age of 12. Played at Varanasi all night classical music offering at Sankat Mochan Mandir. The story behind this exquisite composition is something very rare which can be heard about further at through Sitar
